title: Stripe webhook handlePaymentFailed - subscription not found

error_signal.message: vocator-backend Error: handlePaymentFailed Cannot read properties of null (reading 'companyId') in stripe webhook handler

ground_truth.root_cause_description: Stripe webhook receives payment_intent.payment_failed event for a subscription that was already deleted. handlePaymentFailed assumes the billing record exists.
ground_truth.fix_description: Add null check for billing record lookup before accessing companyId
